4TH AMENDMENT
Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Planning Service

THE Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Planning Service published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1670/32 dated 10thof September 2010 of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka as amended by the Gazette ExtraordinaryNo. 1783/37 dated 09th of November 2012, No. 1816/32 dated 28th of June 2013 and No. 1992/77 dated 11th ofNovember 2016, of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka is amended as follows and these amended provisionswill be made effective from 26th of February 2019, the date on which the Cabinet of Ministers made the policy decision.
By Order of the Public Service Commission,
M. A. B. DAYA SENARATH,Secretary,Public Service Commission.
07th August, 2019.

Note

The officers who are to be promoted to Grade II and have completed the qualifications referred to in the amended 10.1.1.1as at 26th of February 2019, the date on which the Cabinet of Ministers made the policy decision and the officers whowere promoted to Grade II prior to such date will be promoted to Grade I from the date they complete a period of 12 yearsof active and satisfactory service in Grade III and II and all other qualifications referred to under 10.2.1.1 excluding thequalification in 10.2.1.1(i).
